description: This file 'utf8.h' provides declarations for functions and types related to UTF-8 string handling, encoding detection, and text formatting in a C/C++ project, likely part of a larger Git-related codebase.

methods.name: display_mode_esc_sequence_len
methods.description: Determines the length of display mode escape sequences in a string.

methods.name: utf8_width
methods.description: Calculates the width of a UTF-8 string for display purposes.

methods.name: utf8_strnwidth
methods.description: Calculates the display width of a given UTF-8 string with a specified length and optional ANSI skip.

methods.name: utf8_strwidth
methods.description: Calculates the display width of an entire UTF-8 string.

methods.name: is_utf8
methods.description: Checks if a given string is valid UTF-8.

methods.name: is_encoding_utf8
methods.description: Checks if a given encoding name indicates UTF-8.

methods.name: same_encoding
methods.description: Determines if two encoding names refer to the same encoding.

methods.name: utf8_fprintf
methods.description: Prints formatted UTF-8 output to a FILE stream.

methods.name: skip_utf8_bom
methods.description: Skips the UTF-8 BOM in a string if present.

methods.name: strbuf_add_wrapped_text
methods.description: Adds wrapped text into a string buffer with indentation and line width.

methods.name: strbuf_add_wrapped_bytes
methods.description: Adds wrapped byte data into a string buffer.

methods.name: strbuf_utf8_align
methods.description: Aligns UTF-8 text within a string buffer according to specified alignment and width.

methods.name: has_prohibited_utf_bom
methods.description: Checks for prohibited BOM in UTF-16/32 data.

methods.name: is_missing_required_utf_bom
methods.description: Checks if a required BOM is missing for encoded data.
